name: leios_fast
description: Local testnet that starts in Dijkstra and has epoch length suitable for EBs.

control_env.DBSYNC_SCHEMA_DIR: will start and configure db-sync if the value is path to db-sync schema directory
control_env.SMASH: if set, will start and configure smash
control_env.ENABLE_EXPERIMENTAL: if set, experimental features will be enabled in the local cluster
control_env.UTXO_BACKEND: 'mem', 'disk', 'disklmdb' or `empty`, default is `empty` (mem without configuration) if unset
control_env.NO_CC: if set, will not create committee
control_env.DRY_RUN: if set, will not start the cluster
control_env.PROTOCOL_VERSION: if set, will use the specified protocol version (e.g., 11 for latest Conway, etc.)
control_env.NO_POOLS_IN_GENESIS: if set, pool parameters are submitted in a pool re-registration Tx instead of being written into the genesis; the genesis default is a workaround for pool re-registration failing with 'VRFKeyHashAlreadyRegistered' on testnets that start in Dijkstra; the workaround is not needed with HF_TO_DIJKSTRA
control_env.HF_TO_DIJKSTRA: if set and PROTOCOL_VERSION is 12 or higher, will start in Conway PV11 and hard fork to Dijkstra PV12 through a governance action, for node versions that cannot start in Dijkstra directly
control_env.ENABLE_TX_GENERATOR: if set, will configure and start tx-generator
control_env.ENABLE_TX_CENTRIFUGE: if set, will configure and start tx-centrifuge (higher-load, UTxO-reusing successor of tx-generator)
control_env.ENABLE_TX_FIREHOSE: if set, will configure and start tx-firehose (single-node, push-based tx load generator over node-to-client)
control_env.TX_TPS: transactions-per-second rate ceiling for tx-generator / tx-centrifuge / tx-firehose, default is 100
control_env.USE_GENESIS_MODE: if set, will switch to using GenesisMode and peer snapshot file
